scale.benefit_strength: 1-10 only if quantified comparable clinical outcomes
scale.evidence_quality: 1-10 anchored to study design, bias, consistency, applicability
scale.risk_likelihood: 1-10 only with incidence estimates by exposure
scale.dose_match: 1-10 if label and studied dosage known

traffic_light.red: serious contraindication or danger; never overridden by efficacy score

no_global_score: do not aggregate heterogeneous endpoints or multiply risk by benefit to create an apparent clinical truth
safety_override: high-dose beta-carotene in current/former smokers or asbestos exposure
kelp with thyroid disease, excess iodine or unknown iodine dosing
nonmedical: algorithm educational, not diagnosis/personalized medication recommendation
